messages:
alex gonzalez: heads up — tenant 'mosaic' is in a forced scale-loop, started ~11:10 UTC. customers seeing intermittent 429s and p95 latency spikes (600-800ms). alert fired for dedicated pool.

sre-bot: alert: dedicated_autoscale_flap tenant=mosaic pool=dedicated-mosaic events=5 last_event=1998765430

maria chen: on it. any repro steps or recent config changes we should know about?

sam patel: pulling autoscaler logs now. seeing repeat pattern: scale up, then scale down within ~30s. counts: scale_up=7 scale_down=6 in last 12m.

jordan lee: what is the cooldown for this pool? my guess is our cooldown is too short for bursty embed traffic.

alex gonzalez: current pool config: min_cooldown=30s, cooldown_window=60s. workload seems to be short burst -> KV cache cold misses -> high compute -> drop.

maria chen: can you paste the promql or the metric that triggers scaling? also sample request pattern?

sam patel: promql I used for rate: `sum by (pool) (increase(routing.success_total{pool="dedicated-mosaic"}[1m]))`  -- peaks to ~250rps then back to ~20rps in ~45s.

sam patel: quick repro I ran locally: 1) blast 300rps for 30s to pool; 2) drop to 10rps; 3) observe scaler behavior. Observed: scale up 2 instances, scale down immediately, then another scale up after short delay -> saw 3 scale cycles.

maria chen: yep that's classic noisy short-burst oscillation. Our scaler uses a short sampling window + average CPU which is noisy. Suggest: increase smoothing window to 60s and require 2 consecutive windows over threshold (hysteresis). Also lengthen cooldown for this tenant.

jordan lee: agree. proposal: set window=60s, consecutive=2, cooldown=180s for mosaic pool. Also add prefix KV warmup on scale-up to reduce cold misses.

alex gonzalez: customer logged INC-9876 at 11:12 UTC. @support-bot can you attach logs and link the ticket?

support-bot: Ticket INC-9876 updated: logs uploaded -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-9876

sam patel: small canary patch I can rollout now (mosaic-canary):
```
scale_cutoffs:
  policy: moving_average
  window: 60s
  consecutive: 2
  cooldown: 180s
```
Will also enable a short 10s KV prefetch on new instances. Want me to roll to canary pool?

maria chen: yes roll canary. monitor for 10m and mute the noisy autoscale alert for that canary so we don't get alert storms.

alex gonzalez: roles: sam -> deploy canary, maria -> monitor metrics & update customer engineer, jordan -> prepare rollback command/runbook.

jordan lee: ack. I'll draft rollback snippet: `redwoodctl rollout cancel --pool mosaic-canary` and keep a snapshot of scaler config.

sam patel: rolling to mosaic-canary now... rollout complete. initial 3m stable, no extra scale events in that window.

maria chen: monitoring dashboard: no repeat scale cycles for last 6m, p95 reduced to ~120ms, error rate down. Looks promising.

alex gonzalez: great. next steps: add tenant-specific runbook + automated cooldown profile for bursty tenants. i'll update INC-9876 with notes and mitigation steps.

sre-bot: incident status: monitoring. Will auto-close if stable for 1h.

alex gonzalez: closing thread for now — will follow up in ticket. :thumbsup:
